findings.message: 1 card(s) hold a blank band inside: 48px in "CLI 日志阅读器".
findings.fix: A card stretches to its neighbour only when it has content to fill. Keep a legend or a note directly under its chart (only an action or a total may sit at a stretched card's foot), let a short card keep its own height (align-items: start), and let a filtered block shrink to its rows.

findings.message: 2 stretch(es) of the page hold nothing at all: 88px at 1540px; 84px at 1724px (the screen is 200px tall).
findings.fix: Close the gap: a section gap is 120–240px on desktop and 72–112px on a phone. Look for a min-height: 100vh on a short section, an empty grid row, a hidden element still holding its space, or a reveal that never fired. A deliberate rest is a placed picture or colour field, not nothing.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.
Check that it is a deliberate rest (once per page at most); otherwise close it to the normal section gap.

findings.message: 1 pair(s) of cards in one row end at different heights (by 114px).
findings.fix: Cards that share a row share a bottom edge: balance them by their content (the same number of rows, a block of similar height beside it), or stack them. In testing, ragged rows were marked down every time.
